title: FPP pluginList.json
description: The master index of community plugins shown in FPP's Plugin Manager.

pluginList.description: One entry per plugin: [displayName, pluginInfoURL, category, dateAdded].

items.description: A positional tuple; all four elements are required. FPP reads entries by index (older releases only [0] and [1]) and ignores elements it doesn't know.

prefixItems.description: Display/repo name (used as the entry key).
Raw URL to the plugin's pluginInfo.json. Must be hosted on GitHub — that's the only source FPP plugins support.
Category short name (must exist in pluginCategories.json).
Date the plugin was first listed, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (UTC): the date its listing PR was prepared. Set once and never changed; a correction goes in a PR that changes nothing but dates.
